question: Town P is to the north of town Q. Town Q is to the east of town R. Town T is to the north of town P. Town S is to the east of town P. What is the position of town S with respect to town Q?
solution:
• Town P is to the north of town Q.
 
• Town Q is to the east of town R.
 
• Town T is to the north of town P.
 
• Town S is to the east of town P
